scale.label: Not demonstrated
scale.description: Evidence is missing, or the required behavior fails.

scale.label: Partly demonstrated
scale.description: Some behavior works, but important cases or evidence are missing.

scale.label: Meets the stated contract
scale.description: Specific evidence supports the required behavior and important failure cases.

scale.label: Strong evidence and reasoning
scale.description: The contract is met, with additional regression evidence and clear trade-off reasoning.

note: A review records a person's judgment against this rubric. It does not certify expertise or increase skill mastery. Test output is learner-reported; the academy has not executed it.

python-expenses.title: Validated summaries

python-event-timeline.title: Regression evidence

python-log-stream.title: Tests and explanation

python-bounded-offload.title: Admission, order & borrowed ownership

python-measured-cache.expectation: Provide actual public-test/type/lint/source/wheel/install/demo output, two regressions, supported generic old/new callers and warning location/error behavior. Keep finite tests/manual judgment separate from mastery.

python-ingestion-persistence.title: Installed persistence & review evidence
python-ingestion-persistence.expectation: Provide actual public tests/types/lint/source/wheel/fresh-install/demo output, two regressions and typed earlier-record integration. Distinguish skipped checks, reported/manual evidence, mastery and full deployment.

python-ingestion-service.title: Migrations, installed service & review evidence

python-competing-ingestion.title: Installed competition & review evidence
python-competing-ingestion.expectation: Provide actual tests/types/lint/source/wheel/fresh-install/JSON and previous-service API evidence, two regressions, timeout reset and resource cleanup. Report skips/models/limits honestly; no automatic mastery, hard deadline or durable recovery claim.

python-stream-delivery.title: Installed broker & recovery evidence
python-stream-delivery.expectation: Provide five source/wheel builds, clean installed types/resources/quiet import/checks/actual JSON and prior API permissions. Add regressions, prove owned cleanup and label skips/models/crashes/restart boundaries honestly.

python-delivery-release.expectation: Provide source/wheel/fresh installation/types/public cases and actual PostgreSQL/Redis JSON, loopback process cleanup and two added regressions. Name skips and limits; separate reported/manual evidence from mastery.

python-query-analysis.expectation: Show full-key scope, note-fanout prevention, zero/equal/empty/absent behavior, gaps/previous/delta/explicit frames and newest flags before output limits. Add useful regressions.

python-query-analysis.title: JSONB & newest search

python-query-analysis.title: Read ownership & compatibility
python-query-analysis.expectation: Show read-only released connections, actual write/timeout rollback, copied output and caller-owned engines. Preserve source facts/head/metadata and explain prior application authorization/separate snapshots.

python-query-analysis.expectation: Provide actual installed SQL/types/tests/JSON, stated deterministic workload/ANALYZE, equivalent ordered results, baseline/indexed selective/wide node/row/loop/buffer/cost/time observations and restored fixture indexes/owned cleanup. python-api-depth.title: Validators & permission
python-api-depth.expectation: Show exact response-byte tags, private validation, bodyless weak/list/wildcard 304, changed/empty/limited/scoped representations and permission before condition/store with no error ETags.

python-api-depth.expectation: Show real competing receipt insertion, stable resigned retries, changed-body/read conflicts, rollback/lock-timeout cleanup and preserved prior API/head/no implicit outbox; state external effect limits.

python-api-depth.title: Installed requests & original evidence
python-api-depth.expectation: Provide clean artifacts/types/public cases, actual loopback report/status/database counts, an independent regression, owned cleanup and manual interpretation without certification/public deployment claims.

python-practical-review.title: Object, typing & caller compatibility
python-practical-review.expectation: Show exact copied public page/cursor, complete-key conflict/latest selection, zero/domain refusal, Record/Row/Snapshot/generic mapping, installed strict types and preserved old HTTP/no-store/duplicates/rollback/readiness plus deprecated caller warning/identity.

python-practical-review.title: Resource & async failure ownership
python-practical-review.expectation: Show borrowed client/Engine/tracer, owned response cleanup on cancellation/error, partial acquisition cleanup/original propagation, context restoration and separate-page snapshot/uncertain effect limits.

python-practical-review.title: Bounded work & process boundaries
python-practical-review.expectation: Show eight-page/body/row/result/request/cache bounds, worker/pending limits, actual thread/spawn values, worker-local closed files, joined shutdown and no shared Engine; distinguish bounds from hard deadlines/hostile load proofs.

tools.expectation: Show one local note/receipt transaction, scoped application operation ID independent of model IDs, identical replay/conflicting payload, reopen, caps and late SQL rollback. Replays still check current approval/source. Observe timeout/cancellation after commit and explicit receipt reconciliation; do not claim remote exactly-once or undo a committed effect.

tools.title: Installed artifacts, budgets & original review
tools.expectation: Provide exact versions/commands, four archives/wheels/outside-source typed imports and computed tools.json. Show full request/output/cost admission, one shared cooperative deadline, step limits, cleanup and uncertain outcomes without automatic effect retry. Add an original predicted regression and policy tradeoff; distinguish controlled local checks and reported/self/human evidence from model quality, production authority and mastery.

ai-evaluation.title: Versioned cases & current observations
ai-evaluation.expectation: Show strict packaged development cases, complete fixed scenario coverage, dataset/candidate/source/model/prompt/schema digests and actual composed observations. Observe missing/stale/private evidence and role/URL/extra-field tool rejection; do not claim real model or general SSRF protection.

ai-evaluation.title: Exact measurements & privacy
ai-evaluation.expectation: Show requested-k precision, positive-label recall/MRR, separate unlabelled unwanted hits and exact inclusive fractions. Measure expected answer/tool/effect boundaries separately from permission/privacy. Preserve threshold misses and uncertain committed effects; redact raw source/query/arguments/private exceptions and state metadata risks.

ai-evaluation.title: Pinned gates & explicit semantic review
ai-evaluation.expectation: Show pinned policy/dataset identity, incomplete/mixed/duplicate/stale failure, objective permission/privacy blocks and separately pending/rejected/recorded quality. Review ordinary/malicious quoted answers explicitly with candidate-bound reported identity/notes; no invented rating or reviewer authentication. Manual approval cannot override an objective failure.

ai-evaluation.title: Installed artifacts & connected independent review
ai-evaluation.expectation: Provide source revision, exact versions/commands, five archives/wheels/outside-source typed imports/case resources and actual release.json. Label simulated mutations separately, add an original predicted regression and threshold/coverage decision. Audit connected lesson/layer/prerequisite/project paths while preserving earlier definitions and manual artifacts. State finite development/controlled/provider/production/mastery limits.

exam-knowledge.title: Python
exam-knowledge.expectation: Reviewer: require explicit client lifetime, cancellation/awaited cleanup, limits and an observed failure test.

exam-knowledge.title: HTTP and API
exam-knowledge.expectation: Reviewer: require concrete API examples, actor-derived scope, request-bound replay, conflict and reconciliation.

exam-knowledge.title: PostgreSQL
exam-knowledge.expectation: Reviewer: require measured query count, complete join keys, result equivalence, workload and honest limits.

exam-knowledge.title: Distributed systems
exam-knowledge.expectation: Reviewer: require named commit/ack windows, durable observer facts, duplicate tests and external-effect limits.

exam-knowledge.title: Architecture and operations
exam-knowledge.expectation: Reviewer: require measurable user outcome, workload, thresholds, compatible rollback and restore evidence.

exam-knowledge.title: Applied AI and RAG
exam-knowledge.expectation: Reviewer: require reproducible candidates, denominators, permissions, held-out use and separate semantic quality.

exam-knowledge.title: Tool calling and finance
exam-knowledge.expectation: Reviewer: require separated transcript/proposal/approval/execution, exact money, permissions and durable reconciliation.

exam-knowledge.title: Security
exam-knowledge.expectation: Reviewer: require concrete actor/source/tool boundaries, adversarial cases, URL controls and limits.

exam-design.title: Explicit requirements and capacity
exam-design.expectation: State measurable SLOs, workload arithmetic, tenant assumptions, non-goals and changing limits.

exam-design.title: Data and service design
exam-design.expectation: Show full keys/indexes, API contracts, write ownership, caching/queues and justified trade-offs.

exam-design.title: Permissions and action authority
exam-design.expectation: Enforce current ACLs at every exposure, strict tools and exact action approval; include adversarial tests.

exam-design.title: Failures and durable effects
exam-design.expectation: Reason about commit/ack gaps, destination cooperation, retries, fallback, duplicate receipts and uncertain outcomes.

exam-design.title: Retrieval and semantic quality
exam-design.expectation: Preserve sources/versions/citations, measured hybrid retrieval and held-out labels, independent human quality checks.

exam-design.title: Operations, recovery and cost
exam-design.expectation: Give safe traces, budgets, deploy/rollback, restore drills and concrete RPO/RTO/SLO evidence.

exam-design.title: Incident adaptation
exam-design.expectation: For each incident revise earlier assumptions, choose a response, explain trade-offs and define a verification experiment.

exam-repair.title: State and transactions
exam-repair.expectation: Show atomic order/reservation/outbox state, request-bound replay/conflicts and the rollback regression. Distinguish sequential SQLite fixtures from PostgreSQL races.

exam-repair.title: Retry and duplicate effects
exam-repair.expectation: Explain commit-before-ack, durable inbox design, bounded retries, poison cases and destination cooperation. The offline event fixture is not a real broker.

exam-repair.title: SQL and caching
exam-repair.expectation: Show full tenant join keys, correct grain, actual query counts/plans and cache version/ACL behavior. The private contract cannot certify SQL performance.

exam-repair.title: API and tool authority
exam-repair.expectation: Validate actor scope, exact schemas, action approval and receipt reconciliation. Add HTTP boundary and malicious-document tests beyond this offline core.

exam-repair.title: Retrieval and honest answers
exam-repair.expectation: Return only authorized current support, deterministic ranking and explicit refusal. Exact quote matching is not semantic quality or an injection guarantee.

exam-repair.title: Async lifetime
exam-repair.expectation: Bound live jobs, handle failure, await cancellation/cleanup and record a real async regression.

exam-repair.title: Architecture, Docker and observability
exam-repair.expectation: Separate request/state/retrieval/tool ownership. Repair the Dockerfile, add redacted traces, startup/health and a reproducible launch. Provide observed evidence rather than checklist claims.
